nodes.name: Webhook — Vehicle Telemetry
nodes._comment: Receives 10Hz telemetry from each vehicle (6 vehicles = up to 60 requests/sec). Payload: { vehicle_id, timestamp_utc, lat, lon, alt_ft_agl, speed_kmh, battery_pct, health_status, abort_status }

nodes.name: Altitude Band Compliance Check
nodes._comment: Routes Class A (AE-*, JT-*) vs Class B (AUTO-*, PAYLOAD-*) for different band checks

nodes.name: Class A Band Violation? (30–80m AGL)
nodes._comment: 30m = ~98ft AGL, 80m = ~262ft AGL. Violation triggers safety-monitor abort.

nodes.name: Update Redis — Live Telemetry State
nodes._comment: Stores latest telemetry in Redis (5s TTL). Score engine and safety monitor read from here.

nodes.name: Trigger Gate Proximity Check
nodes._comment: Fires gate-trigger workflow on every telemetry update for proximity evaluation

_meta.description: Ingests real-time vehicle telemetry at 10Hz per vehicle, validates altitude band compliance, stores to Redis, and triggers gate proximity checks.
